title: Photorealistic cinematic vertical smartp
prompt:
Photorealistic cinematic vertical smartphone selfie of a clearly adult young woman in her early twenties, around 20 years old, standing outdoors beside a lush urban sidewalk in daylight. Her specific ethnicity or race should remain unspecified because it cannot be reliably determined from appearance alone. She has very fair, smooth skin with soft neutral-to-pink undertones and realistic natural texture, a petite softly tapered oval face, a delicate jawline, a small refined nose, softly flushed cheeks, and naturally rosy-red lips. Her large almond-shaped dark brown eyes are emphasized with fine black eyeliner, defined lashes, and vivid pink-red eyeshadow extending subtly toward the outer corners. Her expression is gentle, cheerful, and relaxed, with a small closed-mouth smile as she looks directly into the camera.

Her hair is extremely long, straight, glossy, and deep black-brown, reaching well below her waist. It is styled with blunt straight bangs cut across the forehead, short face-framing sections curving inward around the cheeks, and the majority of the hair gathered loosely over one shoulder into a low side ponytail secured near the neck with a pale cream fabric accessory. Individual strands remain natural and slightly tousled.

She holds the camera at arm’s length with one arm extended prominently toward the lower foreground, creating a casual wide-angle selfie perspective. Her upper body is turned slightly toward the lens while her opposite arm relaxes beside her body. Frame her from approximately mid-thigh upward.

She wears exactly a fitted white sleeveless spaghetti-strap dress with narrow shoulder straps, a softly shaped neckline, ruched fabric through the torso, and a prominent vertical cascading ruffle running down the front. The dress follows her figure closely without additional layers. A pale cream shoulder bag hangs at her side, partially visible behind her extended arm.

The background shows a sunlit city sidewalk with mature trees, green foliage, a chain-link fence, reddish ornamental plants with long pointed leaves, large planters, a pale textured wall, structural beams, and glimpses of the street and distant buildings. Soft natural daylight creates bright, flattering illumination with mild highlight bloom and gentle shadows.
